name: bk_exp05_planted
title: A planted bridge flips the model's answer from layer 34 on, and all three readers report it
caption: A: share of 614 two-hop country items (e.g. 'the capital of the country famous for ...') where swapping the bridge country's class-mean projection at that layer (centred clamp, smallest dose up to 4x the class-mean gap) flips the model's answer while leaving it intact; Wilson 95% CIs, kept counts on bars. B: on 200 kept layer-38 items, share where each reader's layer-42 log-odds prefers the planted country Y over the text-implied X (mean of 3 templates), Wilson 95%. Caveat: the swap direction is strongly J-enriched (6.5x) and doses are large, so this is a calibration that reading works for in-J content, not a test of non-J reading.

notes: Reader templates: Oracle Lens '- {c}', '- {c} (country)', '- The country of {c}'; NLA '{c}', 'The text is about {c}', 'A factual question involving {c}' after '<explanation>\n'. RESULTS rounds Oracle Lens unplanted 0.005 to 0.01 and NLA planted 0.985 to 0.98.
